extracted.intended_audience: Reviewers invited to NIH scientific review meetings who need to access Internet Assisted Review (IAR) via eRA Commons; also scientific review officers (SROs) and existing eRA Commons account holders who need IAR privileges.
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step guidance for reviewers on how to log into eRA Commons and access the Internet Assisted Review (IAR) module, how to create or update an eRA Commons account, and which tools (Login.gov, 2FA) and resources to use. Focused on reviewers invited by a scientific review officer (SRO).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Login.gov when invited to a review meeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers will need to use Login.gov when invited to a review meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On the eRA Commons screen, reviewers will click the Login.gov logo and be prompted to create a Login.gov account and to associate it with their Commons account (one-time only). See Login.gov Instructions for Reviewers flyer. For screenshots and more information, see the referenced webpage and 2FA flyer.

rubrics_metrics.name: eRA Commons account required to access IAR
rubrics_metrics.description: IAR is accessed via eRA Commons; therefore, reviewers need an eRA Commons account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the reviewer is a principal investigator with an account in eRA Commons, they can use that account with IAR privileges added. If the reviewer is new to eRA Commons, they can create a new account after being invited by an SRO. If the reviewer has previously served, they can use the previously established account with IAR privileges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a new eRA Commons account only after SRO invitation
rubrics_metrics.description: How to create an account to access IAR -- only for those reviewers who are new to eRA Commons, and have been invited by a scientific review officer to create a new account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Account creation should be done in response to the invitation emails from the SRO; see the sample text of emails sent to reviewers for next-step details.

rubrics_metrics.name: IAR privileges must be added to existing accounts when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal investigators or reviewers with existing eRA Commons accounts must have IAR privileges added to those accounts to access IAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you already have an eRA Commons account, request or follow instructions to add IAR privileges rather than creating a duplicate account. This preserves access continuity for reviewers who have served previously.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must be logged into IAR via eRA Commons with appropriate role(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: * You must be logged into IAR via eRA Commons with appropriate role(s) to complete these activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your Commons account has the roles/privileges required for the tasks you need to perform in IAR (reviewing, accessing application materials, etc.). Role assignment typically follows the SRO invitation process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access IAR from the eRA Commons landing screen (two methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Once logged in to eRA Commons, you can access IAR in one of two ways: Click on the IAR button on the left side of the screen, or click on the apps icon on the upper left corner of the screen to access IAR from the drop-down menu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the IAR button or the apps icon drop-down as shown in Figures 1–3 (screenshots). The page provides screenshots illustrating both options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow SRO emails about next steps
rubrics_metrics.description: When a scientific review officer (SRO) invites a reviewer to a meeting, the reviewer gets emails about next steps in the process (see sample text of emails sent to reviewers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read and follow the email instructions from the SRO carefully — these contain account-creation invitations, links, and role/privilege information needed to access IAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the provided training resources and tutorials
rubrics_metrics.description: Video tutorials and other resources are provided to help reviewers learn IAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended resources include: 'Reviewers: A Brief Introduction to IAR' (video, 3:19), 'Reviewers: Received an IAR Invitation. Now What?' (video, 5:10), 'IAR Meeting Phases' description, 'Accessing IAR from eRA Commons New Screens', and 'Change password' guidance. Watch/read these before performing review activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference the public IAR link and screenshots for navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: IAR link: http://public.era.nih.gov/iar and the page includes main screenshots demonstrating login and how to locate IAR within eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the public IAR link if needed and consult the screenshots (Figures 1–3) to confirm you're on the correct screens: eRA Commons login, IAR button on landing screen, and apps icon drop-down menu selection.
